description:
A Senior Citizen Health Insurance policy is a type of health insurance plan designed to reduce the financial and physical stress of senior citizens in the event of illness and hospitalization. 

In this video, we have discussed 2 plans specially designed for Senior Citizens & compared them. 
1. Niva Bupa Senior First Plan
2. ICICI Lombard Gold Shield Plan.

We have compared them on various features, waiting periods , exclusions and also calculated the premiums for both.
This video will help you choose the best health insurance plan for senior citizens.

WATCH THE VIDEO FOR MORE DETAILS :)
